records.synonyms_note: Astragalus micranthus Nutt. is an illegitimate later homonym under accepted A. nuttallianus; Hamosa nuttalliana (DC.) Rydb. homotypic. A. pleianthus maps to A. nuttallianus var. pleianthus, not a second accepted species.
records.concept_caution: POWO accepts nine varieties under A. nuttallianus; source is species-rank only, so no variety can be inferred or installed separately without evidence.
